name: working-on-llvm
description: Workflow and conventions for fixing upstream llvm/llvm-project (LLVM/MLIR/Clang) issues and getting PRs merged. Covers building/testing LLVM, minimizing .ll/.mir/MLIR test cases, debugging passes, llvm-reduce/alive2/llubi, and PR hygiene.

interface.shortDescription: LLVM issue, patch, test, and PR workflow
defaultPrompt: Investigate and fix this LLVM issue with focused tests and PR-ready hygiene.
Reduce this crash to a minimal .ll regression test and regenerate the CHECK lines.
Address the reviewer comments on this llvm-project PR.
